# Rin

> Rin is a small programming language: one C++17 engine (Lexer, Parser, Interpreter) that runs from the command line, in the Android IDE (RinStudio) and in the browser via WebAssembly. Site language: Arabic (with English).

## Main pages
- [Rin home](https://dlof-lib.github.io/rinlang/): overview of the language, tour, quick start, FAQ
- [Rin Libraries](https://dlof-lib.github.io/rinlang/?view=libraries): official libraries, community packages and extensions

## URL format
- Library: https://dlof-lib.github.io/rinlang/@USER/NAME.og.rin (official libraries use @rin)
- Extension: https://dlof-lib.github.io/rinlang/@USER/NAME.rinex
- Publisher profile: https://dlof-lib.github.io/rinlang/@USER
- Full list: https://dlof-lib.github.io/rinlang/sitemap.xml
